talk.name: v00
talk.text: 当时，美咲就在我身边——

talk.name: v01
talk.text: 哎呀，那有什么不对吗？

talk.name: v02
talk.text: 啊，燐子！你在做什么？

talk.name: v03
talk.text: 哎呀，育美已经困了吗？

talk.name: v04
talk.text: 咦？对不起，我好像踩到什么东西了

talk.name: v05
talk.text: 谢谢你喜欢这套服装

talk.name: v06
talk.text: 嗯！不过可不只有红薯哦！

talk.name: v07
talk.text: 嗯！花音不管什么时候都很棒！

talk.name: v08
talk.text: 没错，决定了！去坐船吧！！

talk.name: v09
talk.text: 对！是个长得和我一模一样的人哦

talk.name: v10
talk.text: 那就在这里吃午饭吧！

talk.name: v11
talk.text: 有什么难为情的？你穿着非常好看哦，燐子！

talk.name: v12
talk.text: 怎么样？我最喜欢大家了！

talk.name: v13
talk.text: 什么嘛！那不是完全没问题吗？

talk.name: v14
talk.text: 小育～，准备好了吗～？

talk.name: v15
talk.text: 当然，我就是想去挖角她的！

talk.name: v16
talk.text: 里美、沙绫，不用担心！

talk.name: v17
talk.text: 夏莉莉！你觉得游行怎么样！

talk.name: v18
talk.text: 让我们一起度过快乐的一天吧！

talk.name: v19
talk.text: 怎么会失败呢！

talk.name: v20
talk.text: 赢不过？为什么会这样呢？

talk.name: v21
talk.text: 真的呢！我也吓了一跳！

talk.name: v22
talk.text: 花音，等着我！我现在就去救你！

l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 当时，美咲就在我身边——

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v01
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 哎呀，那有什么不对吗？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v02
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 啊，燐子！你在做什么？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v03
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 哎呀，育美已经困了吗？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v04
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 咦？对不起，我好像踩到什么东西了

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v05
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 谢谢你喜欢这套服装

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v06
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 嗯！不过可不只有红薯哦！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v07
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 嗯！花音不管什么时候都很棒！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v08
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 没错，决定了！去坐船吧！！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v09
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 对！是个长得和我一模一样的人哦

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v10
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 那就在这里吃午饭吧！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v11
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 有什么难为情的？你穿着非常好看哦，燐子！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v12
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 怎么样？我最喜欢大家了！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v13
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 什么嘛！那不是完全没问题吗？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v14
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 小育～，准备好了吗～？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v15
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 当然，我就是想去挖角她的！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v16
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 里美、沙绫，不用担心！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v17
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 夏莉莉！你觉得游行怎么样！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v18
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 让我们一起度过快乐的一天吧！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v19
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 怎么会失败呢！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v20
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 赢不过？为什么会这样呢？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v21
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 真的呢！我也吓了一跳！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v22
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 花音，等着我！我现在就去救你！
